claims.claim: Canary /search p99 is more than 5x the stable /search p99 (651 ms vs 61 ms).
18 canary /search requests exceeded 500 ms, while no stable request on any path exceeded 400 ms (stable max 343 ms).
There were zero 5xx responses on either version and all 18 slow canary /search responses returned HTTP 200.
The 18 slow canary /search responses occur in 11 of the 12 ten-second buckets of the test, from t=3.18s to t=113.3s.
Canary /search latency is bimodal: fast cluster max 190 ms, slow cluster min 633 ms, and no request between 200 ms and 600 ms.
/browse and /checkout show no canary regression: canary max latency is <= stable max latency on both paths.
The slow cluster is 2.47% of canary /search requests and 0.76% of all canary requests.
